name: My Website
flavorText: Personal website project to showcase my work and learn front-end development
desc: I started working on my personal portfolio website in June 2021. In the beginning, it was made with plain HTML and CSS as I had just started learning web-development. Throughout 2022, I remade the website using React to improve updatability and learn new skills. In 2023, I made the switch to Angular to continue learning new web-development skills.

name: Clean Bot (CB)
flavorText: A cleaning robot developed using the Lego NXT Platform
desc: Cleanbot, nicknamed CB, was a robot I built as a high school senior for my graduation project. CB was built off of the Lego NXT platform with a few modifications to accomodate a rotating broom arm and dustpan. CB could move, sweep, and avoid obstacles just like a Roomba. Unlike a Roomba, Cleanbot used a ultrasonic sensor to observe its environment.

name: D.R. Wilk Contracting Website
flavorText: A website created for D.R. Wilk Contracting
desc: D.R. Wilk Contracting is my Dad's business he has been running for 20+ years. His company has a presence on Facebook and Instagramm but had an outdated website. As a side project, I created a website for him and his amazing work.

name: Ghoul Game
flavorText: A simple web game made for VolHacks V
desc: Ghoul Game is a web game me and my partner Nick Jackson created at our first hackathon. The premise is simple, click to increase your score, but watch out! There is a chance that the Ghoul will appear. When the Ghoul appears, you will lose all of your points. The game was created using Django, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

name: Big Brain Bot
flavorText: A Discord bot created in Java during my first semester of university
desc: As an avid user of discord, I wanted to created a discord bot of my own. Using my limited programming knowledge, I gave the bot a few commands for users to test. I plan to come back to this bot to add extra features and possible change it over to JavaScript.

name: Github Languages Visualization
flavorText: A visualization of programming languages on Github

flavorText: Housing Price Regression for Kaggle Competition

name: Clustering Netflix
flavorText: A basic Netflix recommender system using K-Means Clustering

name: Angle Financial
flavorText: MEAN-stack online banking application for a ficitional Bank
desc: MEAN-stack Bank app is a banking application for the fictional bank 'Angle Financial' that is modeled after a typical online banking experience. The application uses the MEAN-stack (MongoDb, Express.js, Angular, and Node).

name: Money Recognition
flavorText: Final Project for ITCS 4152/5152 that can detect United States currency (dollar bills and coins)
desc: Currency Recognition can be beneficial for people with special needs and banks (Ex: couting the number of bills someone might have or counterfeit detection). As a team (Soji Ademiluyi, Ben Gambil, Fausto German Jimenez, Joshua Wygal and Myself), we developed a model that can detect the most common kinds of dollar bills and coins used in the United States.

name: Mutli-Robot Collision Safety
flavorText: Collision-free Coordinated Behaviors for Multi-Robot Systems
desc: The rise in popularity of autonomous systems raises concerns for safety. Regardless of the problem the autonomous system is solving, the robots within must perform their actions in a safe manner. My research, under the direction of Dr. Wenhao Luo, explores the concept of Probabilistic Safety Barrier Certificates to minimally modify an existing robot controller to provide probabilistic safety. Experiments were done in both a simulated environment and the real-world.
